name: Giselle
source:
The Demon Queen, wielder of ultimate magic powers, bringer of calamity.
Hedonistic and haughty, while also possessing beauty befitting of a queen, Giselle torments mankind on a whim.
She was also the one responsible for summoning the protagonist from another world.
